title: Correlate CASE Records (Cron)
actions:
  Configuration:
    title: Configuration
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Loads correlation configuration parameters from asset including delay minutes, concurrent limits, match ratios, and number of correlations to return.
    on-success:

    - name: Minimum_String_Match_Ratio
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Correlation_Configuration.Minimum_String_Match_Ratio
    - name: Minimum_Record_Match_Ratio
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Correlation_Configuration.Minimum_Record_Match_Ratio
    inputSchemaReferenceId: f37cdff9-fdb3-40f9-8831-cb633e845de6
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 2f37da98-1171-4cb7-8a4c-4bf205ee53c8
    meta: {}

    title: Prepare Search Values
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Calculates timestamp boundary for searching records by subtracting correlation delay from current time to ensure proper aging before correlation.
    on-success:

    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      get_end_timestamp:

        description: ""
        display:

        inputs:
          expression: $fromMillis($toMillis($now()) - variables.Correlation_Delay_Minutes * 60000)
          data:
            variables:
              Correlation_Delay_Minutes:
                $:ref: $variables.Correlation_Delay_Minutes
        actionType: jsonata

    entrypoint: get_end_timestamp
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Parallel:
    title: Parallel
    type: parallelGroup
    description: >
      Executes three operations simultaneously: marking records as "Processing", fetching correlation pool records, and running the correlation algorithm.
    on-success:
    - ForEach_Processing_CASE_Record: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - Get_CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against

    actions:
      ForEach_Uncorrelated_SIG_Record:
        title: ForEach Uncorrelated SIG Record
        type: loop
        description: >
          Iterates through each pending record in parallel to update their correlation status from "Pending" to "Processing".
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        entrypoints:
        - Update_CASE_Record_Processing
        actions:
          Update_CASE_Record_Processing:
            meta: {}
            title: Update CASE Record to Processing
            type: recordAction
            delay: 0
            pool: ""
            on-success: []
            on-failure: []
            on-complete: []
            publish: {}
            post: {}
            timeout: 0
            description: >
              Updates individual CASE record status to "Processing" to prevent duplicate correlation attempts during current execution.
            inputSchemaReferenceId: bbab78ad-d4f6-4d4c-b192-241e1312b7f9
            inputs:
              applicationName: ""
              applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
              trackingId: "{ $:ref: $loops.ForEach_Uncorrelated_SIG_Record.value['tracking-id'] }"
              patchValues:
                correlation-status: Processing
              removeValues: {}
              appendValues: {}
              restrictions:
                users:
                  operation: append
                  value: []
                groups:
                  operation: append
                  value: []
            recordActionType: patch
        loop:
          type: for
          each:
            $:ref: $actions.Get_CASE_Records_Pending_Correlation.result.records
          parallel: true

        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Get_CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against:
        meta: {}
        title: Get CASE Records to Correlate Against
        type: connector
        delay: 0
        pool: $default
        on-success:
        - Correlation_Script: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Retrieves the pool of all eligible SIG records to compare against when searching for correlations.
        action: $playbook.component_ae5Ul3Z3m6l3Xraun_playbook
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        inputs: {}
      Correlation_Script:
        title: Correlation Script
        type: python
        description: >
          Python script that compares pending records against the pool using fuzzy matching on all fields, calculating similarity scores and identifying top matches.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
          code: "import json\nfrom difflib import SequenceMatcher\n\ntracking_ids = []\ncontexts = []\ncorrelations_found = False\n\n\ndef parse_value(value):\n    \"\"\"\n    Parse a value that might be a stringified JSON object/array.\n    Returns the parsed value or the original value if parsing fails.\n    \"\"\"\n    if isinstance(value, str):\n        # Try to parse as JSON\n        try:\n            parsed = json.loads(value)\n            return parsed\n        except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):\n            # Not JSON, return as-is\n            return value\n    return value\n\n\ndef extract_key_value_pairs(obj, prefix=\"\"):\n    \"\"\"\n    Recursively extract key-value pairs from an object.\n    Returns a dictionary of flattened key-value pairs.\n    Only includes strings and string arrays with length >= 1.\n    \"\"\"\n    pairs = {}\n    \n    if isinstance(obj, dict):\n        for key, value in obj.items():\n            full_key = f\"{prefix}.{key}\" if prefix else key\n            parsed_value = parse_value(value)\n            \n            if isinstance(parsed_value, str):\n                # Only include non-empty strings\n                if len(parsed_value) >= 1:\n                    pairs[full_key] = parsed_value\n            elif isinstance(parsed_value, list):\n                # Check if it's a list of strings\n                if all(isinstance(item, str) for item in parsed_value):\n                    pairs[full_key] = parsed_value\n                elif any(isinstance(item, (dict, list)) for item in parsed_value):\n                    # List contains objects, recurse into them\n                    for idx, item in enumerate(parsed_value):\n                        if isinstance(item, (dict, list)):\n                            nested_pairs = extract_key_value_pairs(item, f\"{full_key}[{idx}]\")\n                            pairs.update(nested_pairs)\n                        elif isinstance(item, str) and len(item) >= 1:\n                            pairs[f\"{full_key}[{idx}]\"] = item\n            elif isinstance(parsed_value, dict):\n                # Nested object, recurse\n                nested_pairs = extract_key_value_pairs(parsed_value, full_key)\n                pairs.update(nested_pairs)\n    elif isinstance(obj, list):\n        # Handle list at root level\n        if all(isinstance(item, str) for item in obj):\n            # Only include non-empty arrays\n            if len(obj) >= 1:\n                pairs[prefix] = obj\n        else:\n            for idx, item in enumerate(obj):\n                if isinstance(item, (dict, list)):\n                    nested_pairs = extract_key_value_pairs(item, f\"{prefix}[{idx}]\")\n                    pairs.update(nested_pairs)\n                elif isinstance(item, str) and len(item) >= 1:\n                    pairs[f\"{prefix}[{idx}]\"] = item\n    elif isinstance(obj, str):\n        # Only include non-empty strings\n        if len(obj) >= 1:\n            pairs[prefix] = obj\n        \n    return pairs\n\n\ndef calculate_string_similarity(str1, str2, minimum_ratio):\n    \"\"\"\n    Calculate similarity between two strings.\n    If minimum_ratio is 1.0, requires exact match.\n    Otherwise uses overlap matching.\n    Only considers strings with length >= 1.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Skip empty strings\n    if len(str1) < 1 or len(str2) < 1:\n        return 0.0\n    \n    if str1 == str2:\n        return 1.0\n    \n    if minimum_ratio >= 1.0:\n        # Exact match required\n        return 0.0\n    \n    # Use overlap matching for case-insensitive comparison\n    str1_lower = str1.lower()\n    str2_lower = str2.lower()\n    \n    if str1_lower == str2_lower:\n        return 1.0\n    \n    # Calculate similarity ratio using SequenceMatcher\n    ratio = SequenceMatcher(None, str1_lower, str2_lower).ratio()\n    return ratio\n\n\ndef calculate_array_similarity(arr1, arr2, minimum_ratio):\n    \"\"\"\n    Calculate similarity between two string arrays.\n    Returns the ratio of matching elements.\n    Only considers arrays with length >= 1.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Skip empty arrays\n    if len(arr1) < 1 or len(arr2) < 1:\n        return 0.0\n    \n    # Convert to sets for comparison\n    if minimum_ratio >= 1.0:\n        # Exact match required\n        set1 = set(arr1)\n        set2 = set(arr2)\n    else:\n        # Case-insensitive comparison\n        set1 = set(s.lower() for s in arr1)\n        set2 = set(s.lower() for s in arr2)\n    \n    intersection = len(set1 & set2)\n    union = len(set1 | set2)\n    \n    if union == 0:\n        return 0.0\n    \n    return intersection / union\n\n\ndef compare_values(value1, value2, minimum_string_ratio):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compare two values and return a similarity score.\n    Handles both strings and string arrays.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Both are strings\n    if isinstance(value1, str) and isinstance(value2, str):\n        return calculate_string_similarity(value1, value2, minimum_string_ratio)\n    \n    # Both are arrays\n    if isinstance(value1, list) and isinstance(value2, list):\n        return calculate_array_similarity(value1, value2, minimum_string_ratio)\n    \n    # Different types - no match\n    return 0.0\n\n\ndef compare_records(current_signal, signal_record, minimum_string_ratio, minimum_record_ratio):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compare current_signal with a signal_record.\n    Returns a tuple of (overall_match_ratio, matched_fields_details).\n    \"\"\"\n    # Extract all key-value pairs from both records (exclude tracking-id from similarity)\n    def drop_tracking_id(pairs):\n        return {k: v for k, v in pairs.items() if k != \"tracking-id\" and not k.endswith(\".tracking-id\")}\n    current_pairs = drop_tracking_id(extract_key_value_pairs(current_signal))\n    record_pairs = drop_tracking_id(extract_key_value_pairs(signal_record))\n    \n    # Find common keys\n    common_keys = set(current_pairs.keys()) & set(record_pairs.keys())\n    \n    if not common_keys:\n        return 0.0, {}\n    \n    # Calculate similarity for each common key\n    matched_fields = {}\n    total_match_score = 0.0\n    \n    for key in common_keys:\n        similarity = compare_values(current_pairs[key], record_pairs[key], minimum_string_ratio)\n        \n        # Only consider it a match if it meets the minimum string match ratio\n        if similarity >= minimum_string_ratio:\n            matched_fields[key] = round(similarity, 3)\n            total_match_score += 1.0\n        elif similarity > 0.0 and minimum_string_ratio < 1.0:\n            # Partial match for fuzzy matching\n            matched_fields[key] = round(similarity, 3)\n            total_match_score += similarity\n    \n    # Calculate overall match ratio based on current_signal's keys\n    # This represents what percentage of current_signal's fields matched\n    total_keys_in_current = len(current_pairs)\n    \n    if total_keys_in_current == 0:\n        return 0.0, {}\n    \n    overall_ratio = total_match_score / total_keys_in_current\n    \n    # Only return matches that meet the minimum record match ratio\n    if overall_ratio >= minimum_record_ratio:\n        return overall_ratio, matched_fields\n    \n    return 0.0, {}\n\n\n# Main correlation logic\npending_records = action_inputs[\"CASE_Records_Pending_Correlation\"]\npool_records = action_inputs[\"CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against\"]\ncorrelations_to_return = action_inputs[\"Correlations_to_Return\"]\nminimum_string_ratio = action_inputs[\"Minimum_String_Match_Ratio\"]\nminimum_record_ratio = action_inputs[\"Minimum_Record_Match_Ratio\"]\n\n# Build one result object per \"SIG Record Pending Correlation\"\naction_outputs = []\n\nfor pending in pending_records:\n    pending_tracking_id = pending.get(\"tracking-id\")\n    pending_organization = pending.get(\"organization\")\n\n    # Only consider pool records with matching organization and exclude self (same tracking-id)\n    candidates = [\n        r for r in pool_records\n        if r.get(\"tracking-id\") != pending_tracking_id\n        and r.get(\"organization\") and r.get(\"organization\") == pending_organization\n    ]\n\n    # Store results for this pending record: (match_ratio, tracking_id, matched_fields)\n    correlation_results = []\n    for record in candidates:\n        match_ratio, matched_fields = compare_records(\n            pending,\n            record,\n            minimum_string_ratio,\n            minimum_record_ratio\n        )\n        if match_ratio > 0:\n            tracking_id = record.get(\"tracking-id\", \"UNKNOWN\")\n            correlation_results.append((match_ratio, tracking_id, matched_fields))\n\n    # Sort by match ratio (descending) and take top N\n    correlation_results.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)\n    top_correlations = correlation_results[:correlations_to_return]\n\n    tracking_ids = [result[1] for result in top_correlations]\n    contexts = [\n        {\n            \"tracking_id\": result[1],\n            \"overall_match_ratio\": round(result[0], 3),\n            \"matched_fields\": result[2]\n        }\n        for result in top_correlations\n    ]\n\n    action_outputs.append({\n        \"tracking_id\": pending_tracking_id,\n        \"record_update\": {\n            \"correlation-status\": \"Complete\",\n            \"correlated-cases\": tracking_ids,\n            \"correlation-context\": contexts,\n            \"correlations-found\": len(top_correlations) > 0\n        }\n    })"
          inputs:
            Correlations_to_Return:
              $:ref: $variables.Correlations_to_Return
            Minimum_String_Match_Ratio:
              $:ref: $variables.Minimum_String_Match_Ratio
            Minimum_Record_Match_Ratio:
              $:ref: $variables.Minimum_Record_Match_Ratio
            CASE_Records_Pending_Correlation:
              $:ref: $actions.Get_CASE_Records_Pending_Correlation.result.records
            CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against:
              $:ref: $actions.Get_CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against.result.published.CASE_Records_to_Correlate_Against
        testInputs:
          inputs: {}
          code: >+
            # Restrictions

            # - No custom package imports

            # - action_outputs = a restricted global variable used to set the output of the script.

            # Attachments

            # See https://docs.swimlane.com/using-the-script-native-action for using attachments in Script native actions.

        inputSchemaReferenceId: 593df3c5-f61d-4972-9b12-94172343a2dd
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Get_CASE_Records_Pending_Correlation:
    meta: {}
    title: Get CASE Records Pending Correlation
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - If_CASE_Records_Pending_Correlation_Exist: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}

    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Searches for CASE records with "Pending" correlation status that are older than the configured delay period, limited by max concurrent correlations.
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      filters:
      - fieldId: ayizq
        filterType: lessThanOrEqual
        value:
          $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Search_Values.result.get_end_timestamp
      - fieldId: a0vh1

        value: 6945a34bad6c05fec8b498ae
      filterType: AND
      returnFields:
      - signal-name
      - signal-type
      - signal-description
      - signal-source
      - mitre-attack-techniques
      - signal-impacted-users
      - signal-impacted-assets
      - signal-impacted-ip-addresses
      - alert-name
      - alert-description
      - alert-categories
      - alert-rules
      - phishing-email-subject
      - phishing-email-from
      - phishing-email-to-addresses
      - phishing-email-cc-addresses
      - phishing-email-reply-to-addresses
      - observables
      - organization
      - phishing-email-text-body
      - tracking-id
      limit:
        $:ref: $variables.Maximum_Concurrent_Correlations
    recordActionType: search
  If_CASE_Records_Pending_Correlation_Exist:
    meta: {}
    title: If CASE Records Pending Correlation Exist
    type: conditional
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Checks if any records were found that need correlation processing before proceeding with parallel correlation workflow.
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 55ad4fe5-e967-47e8-96d3-559f9db436ad
    conditions:
    - action: Parallel
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Get_CASE_Records_Pending_Correlation.result.count
          - $:gt: 0
    else: ""
  ForEach_Processing_CASE_Record:
    meta: {}
    title: ForEach Processing CASE Record
    type: loop
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Iterates through correlation results in parallel to update each record with findings and append timeline entries.
    actions:
      Update_CASE_Record_to_Complete:
        meta: {}
        title: Update CASE Record to Complete
        type: recordAction
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success:
        - Update_CASE_Timeline: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Updates CASE record with correlation results including matched tracking IDs, similarity context, and final "Complete" status.
        inputs:
          applicationName: ""
          applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
          trackingId: '{ $:ref: $loops.ForEach_Processing_CASE_Record.value.tracking_id }'
          patchValues:
            $:ref: $loops.ForEach_Processing_CASE_Record.value.record_update
          removeValues: {}
          appendValues: {}
          restrictions:
            users:
              operation: append
              value: []
            groups:
              operation: append
              value: []
        recordActionType: patch
      Update_CASE_Timeline:
        meta: {}
        title: Update CASE Timeline
        type: connector
        delay: 0
        pool: $default
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Appends timeline entry documenting correlation completion with details about whether correlations were found for this record.
        action: $playbook.component_aXlYrqnbr1i_dcEii_playbook
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        inputs:
          Tracking_ID: '{ $:ref: $loops.ForEach_Processing_CASE_Record.value.tracking_id }'
          Playbook_Name: Correlate CASE Records
          Title: Correlation Complete
          Details: "Correlation of record { $:ref: $loops.ForEach_Processing_CASE_Record.value.tracking_id } completed.  Correlations found: { $:ref: $loops.ForEach_Processing_CASE_Record.value.record_update['correlations-found'] }"
        testInputs: {}
    entrypoints:
    - Update_CASE_Record_to_Complete
    loop:
      type: for
      each:
        $:ref: $actions.Correlation_Script.result
      parallel: true
